title.en_US: Vinput 2.3.6 — Model-aware hotwords and stability fixes
title.zh_CN: Vinput 2.3.6 — 模型感知热词与稳定性修复

text.en_US: Hotwords now follow each sherpa-onnx model family, including BPE-aware X-ASR support with automatic vocabulary provisioning. This release also fixes an input-context menu crash and preserves default configuration values when saving. Note: for hotwords to work with offline/streaming X-ASR models, re-download the model from the model manager so the new BPE vocabulary assets are installed.
text.zh_CN: 热词现在会按 sherpa-onnx 模型家族正确接入，并为 X-ASR 自动生成 BPE 词表。本版本同时修复输入上下文销毁时的菜单崩溃，以及保存配置时默认值丢失的问题。注意：已安装的离线/流式 X-ASR 模型需要重新下载（在模型管理器中删除后重新安装），热词才能生效，因为 BPE 词表资产只在安装时生成。
